mark: SUMMARY - execution provenance of ALREADY PRODUCED artifacts; this stage did not execute any training, forward, backward or patient intervention.

execution_commands.purpose: Train the clean-original single arm on BLCA fold 0, seed 3, 3 epochs, 256 real patches.
execution_commands.note: Exact argv is reconstructed from the run manifest, not copied from a shell transcript; treat the argv string as indicative and the resolved_config.json in the private pack as authoritative.

execution_commands.purpose: Extend the same single arm across folds 0-4, seed 3.
execution_commands.note: This five-fold set already existed on the server. This stage did NOT start or extend it.

execution_commands.purpose: P1/P2/P4/P6 patient-level diagnostics against the existing fold0 last.pt.
execution_commands.important: This script produced p1/p2/p4/p6 ONLY. It does not produce p3, p5 or p7.

The caption baked into this script hardcodes '4.14e-3' and one patient ID. Both are single-patient values, not cohort maxima, and the ID must not be published. The redacted public copy corrects both; the original is preserved separately.

configuration.note: config JSON files themselves are withheld from this public return because they carry absolute server paths; they are listed in missing_artifacts.json and included in the private pack.

source_code_versions.upstream_slot_attention_baseline: Initial clean SlotSPE source from delivery v1, sha256 eb5518a7e7dbc0 (recorded in DCT-Reg commit 38b5e87)

queue.patch_budget_semantics: 256 REAL patch tokens; the P1 series varies this token budget and does not vary slot count
queue.topk_config_status: Actual resolved_config is withheld. Prior field value 2 appears to confuse selected count with ratio; not treated as verified execution ratio.

checkpoint_sha256.note: Five-fold checkpoints have different hashes and are only in the private pack.

device_and_environment.gpu_model_dependency: Results depend on CUDA device and cuDNN kernel selection for floating point reduction order. Bit-identical reproduction on different hardware is NOT guaranteed; see rng_replay control which reproduced exactly on this host.

evaluation_protocol.cindex: Harrell's C implemented in the diagnostic script itself; skips equal event times and pairs whose earlier subject is censored; returns concordant + 0.5*tied over comparable pairs.
evaluation_protocol.risk: risk = -sum(cumprod(1 - sigmoid(logits))) over 4 discrete hazard bins.
evaluation_protocol.risk_direction_note: No C(risk) vs C(-risk) direction-flip test was run in this return. The sign convention above is the producer's; acceptance should verify it before any directional claim.
evaluation_protocol.eval_mode: model.eval(); per-repeat Gumbel/top-k sampling is NOT disabled, which is why 20 repeats of identical forward passes differ.

controls_present.control: identical input under re-established eval seed reproduces logits

controls_present.scope: no repaired/replacement modules in the eval path

controls_missing.control: P6 'original input vs original input, same RNG' zero-change control
P6 paired Gaussian/Gumbel RNG restore between baseline and permuted forward
P6 multiset identity verification of permuted patch sets
P2 distribution over all 28 distinct unordered slot pairs
P4 full-model synchronised slot permutation through selector
controls_missing.consequence: P4 remains a mean-level sanity check
